column1: What is the Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ)?
column2: The period between entering a scope and initializing a let/const binding; accessing it throws ReferenceError.

column1: How does var scope differ from let/const?
column2: var is function-scoped; let/const are block-scoped.

column1: How do arrow functions handle this?
column2: Lexically — they inherit this from the enclosing scope and have no own this.

column1: Why does var + setTimeout in a loop print the same final index?
column2: var is function-scoped so all callbacks share one i; use let or capture per iteration.
